title: Modified-blowup construction with a conormal presentation
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, and let $a:W\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Write $\mathcal J$ for its ideal, $V=T\setminus W$, and $C=\mathcal J/\mathcal J^2$ for its conormal sheaf [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. Suppose $E\twoheadrightarrow C$ is a surjection from a locally free $\mathcal O_W$-module of constant rank $r>0$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. All cohomology and derived categories are ordinary small etale ones, with roots-of-unity twists [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist, lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback, def-pur-support-cohomology]. There is a modified blowup
$$b:B_E=\operatorname{Proj}_T\left(\bigoplus_{n\geq0}(\mathcal J^n\times_{\mathcal J^n/\mathcal J^{n+1}}\operatorname{Sym}^n E)\right)\longrightarrow T,$$
where the modules on $W$ are extended by zero to $T$, multiplication is induced by multiplication of ideal powers and symmetric powers, and relative Proj is [def-nagata-relative-proj]. It is projective, is the identity over $V$, and its inverse image of $W$ is $P=\mathbf P_W(E)=\operatorname{Proj}_W(\operatorname{Sym} E)$, with the symmetric algebra sheaf of [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]. If $E=C$ and the canonical symmetric-to-conormal-algebra map is an isomorphism, $B_E=\operatorname{Bl}_W(T)$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. The sheaf $\mathcal O_{B_E}(1)$ has a canonical trivialization over $V$.

For an invertible sheaf $L$ with a trivialization $s$ off a closed set, write $c_1(L,s)$ for the supported boundary of its relative $\mathbf G_m$-torsor under the Kummer sequence [lem-amb-kummer-any-base]; it changes sign on dualizing $(L,s)$. Let $G_E$ be the supported Gysin operator given by this boundary for $(\mathcal O_{B_E}(1),1_V)$ and composition under supported Hom [lem-amb-closed-support-hom]. Ordinary Chern classes $c_j(E)$ are normalized by $c_0(E)=1$ and the projective-bundle relation $\sum_{j=0}^r(-1)^jc_j(E)\xi^{r-j}=0$, where $\xi=c_1(\mathcal O_P(1))$ and coefficients are pulled to $P$. Put
$$Q_E(\xi)=-\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}(-1)^jc_j(E)\xi^{r-1-j}.$$
Pullback $b^*:H_W^p(T,\Lambda(q))\to H_P^p(B_E,\Lambda(q))$ is injective for all integers $p,q$. There is a unique class $A_{a,E}\in H_W^{2r}(T,\Lambda(r))$ such that $b^*A_{a,E}=G_E(Q_E(\xi))$. Its restriction to $W$ is $(-1)^rc_r(E)$. For every morphism $v:T'\to T$ with $T'$ Noetherian, put $W'=T'\times_TW$, $a':W'\hookrightarrow T'$, $v_W:W'\to W$, and use the canonical surjection $v_W^*E\twoheadrightarrow C_{W'/T'}$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $v^*A_{a,E}=A_{a',v_W^*E}$. Isomorphic conormal presentations give the same class. The supported products used here are the Yoneda compositions under closed-support adjunction and tensor by Tate lines; they are associative and functorial under these pullbacks.

source.place: Expose XVI, 1.1-1.3 (ordinary Chern classes); 2.1 (relative Kummer boundary); 2.2.1.1-2.2.1.5 (modified blowup); Proposition 2.2.2.1 and Corollary 2.2.2.3 (split injection, all bidegrees as explicitly remarked); Definitions 2.2.2.5 and 2.2.2.7; Lemmas 2.2.2.4 and 2.2.2.6; Proposition 2.2.3.1. Conormal sheaf and graded algebra: Stacks Tags 0630 and 0631, divisors.tex.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] with $X=T$, $Y=W$, $I=\mathcal J$, and $n=1$, identifying $\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$ with $\mathbf F_\ell$. Its hypotheses are exactly the given Noetherian closed immersion, invertibility of $\ell$, and rank-$r>0$ locally free conormal presentation. Its degree-$a$ fibre product and coefficientwise multiplication are the algebra displayed in the item. It supplies projectivity of $b$, its identification with the identity over $V$, $b^{-1}W=P(E)$, and invertibility and the canonical trivialization over $V$ of $\mathcal O_{B_E}(1)$. No regularity of the immersion is required.

For the ordinary-blowup clause, suppose $E=C$ and $\psi:\operatorname{Sym}(C)\to\bigoplus_a\mathcal J^a/\mathcal J^{a+1}$ is an isomorphism. The conormal map and its products are those of [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. Projection from the fibre product in degree $a$ to $\mathcal J^a$ has inverse $u\mapsto(u,\psi_a^{-1}(u\bmod\mathcal J^{a+1}))$. These maps respect multiplication since $\psi$ does, and commute with restrictions. Thus the displayed algebra is the sheaf Rees algebra of [def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra]. By [lemma-nagata-relative-proj-exists], its Proj restricts on every affine open to Proj of the corresponding Rees algebra, the affine blowup of [def-nagata-affine-blowup]. The global datum of [def-nagata-global-blowup-glue-data] glues these same affine schemes by the same restriction maps, and [def-nagata-global-blowup] names its glued scheme. Consequently the two gluings agree canonically. This argument uses the stated isomorphism $\psi$, rather than imposing a regular-sequence hypothesis.

source.place: XVI Remark 2.2.1.2, with its graded-algebra argument under the stated symmetric-conormal isomorphism; Stacks 0630 (divisors-definition-conormal-sheaf), 0631 (divisors-equation-conormal-in-degree-n)

proof.text: Use [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities] at $n=1$ for the ordinary small-etale Chern classes of $E$. It gives $c_0(E)=1$, the projective-bundle relation with $\xi=c_1(\mathcal O_P(1))$, and the decomposition whose degree-zero summand is pullback from $W$. By [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus], the relative Kummer class of $(\mathcal O_{B_E}(1),1_V)$ defines $G_E$, restriction of $G_E(z)$ to $P$ is $\xi z$, and dualizing the line with its trivialization negates its supported first Chern class. That statement also identifies the supported action with supported-Hom composition and makes it associative and functorial under pullbacks of pairs. These apply to precisely the pseudo-divisor and products in the item.

The all-bidegree support exact sequence of [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] at $n=1$ gives injectivity of $b^*$ for every integers $p,q$. Set $z=G_E(Q_E(\xi))$. The restriction formula of [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus] and the projective-bundle relation of [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities] give
$$z|_P=\xi Q_E(\xi)=-\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}(-1)^jp^*c_j(E)\xi^{r-j}=(-1)^rp^*c_r(E).$$
Here $p:P\to W$ is the projection; the last equality moves the $j=r$ term in the relation to the other side. This lies in the image of $p^*$. Its class in $H^{2r}(P,\Lambda(r))/p^*H^{2r}(W,\Lambda(r))$ is therefore zero. Exactness gives a preimage $A_{a,E}$ under $b^*$, and injectivity makes it unique. The identical defining equation identifies it with $\gamma_{a,E}$ in the generalized theorem.

source.place: XVI Corollary 2.2.2.3 (including its following all-bidegree remark), Lemmas 2.2.2.4 and 2.2.2.6, Definitions 2.2.2.5 and 2.2.2.7

proof.text: Restrict the defining equation $b^*A_{a,E}=z$ to $P$. Since $b|_P=a\circ p$, this gives $p^*(A_{a,E}|_W)=z|_P=(-1)^rp^*c_r(E)$ by Step 4. The projective-bundle decomposition of [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities] contains $p^*$ as its direct-summand inclusion for $a=0$, so $p^*$ on cohomology is injective. Cancelling it proves $A_{a,E}|_W=(-1)^rc_r(E)$.

For any $v:T'\to T$ with $T'$ Noetherian, the arbitrary-base-change clause of [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] supplies the canonical presentation $v_W^*E\twoheadrightarrow C_{W'/T'}$ and gives $v^*\gamma_{a,E}=\gamma_{a',v_W^*E}$. Step 4 identifies these two $\gamma$ classes with the respective $A$ classes, proving the required equality. Pullback of the Tate lines and its tensor/evaluation compatibility are the canonical isomorphisms in [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. This applies to arbitrary $v$, without a flatness hypothesis or an assertion that the modified blowup is its scheme-theoretic base change.

source.place: XVI Proposition 2.2.3.1 (using Proposition 2.2.1.5 in the source)

proof.text: Let $u:E'\xrightarrow{\sim}E$ be an isomorphism respecting the maps to $C$. Apply the vector-bundle-surjection formula in [lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class] to $u$. Its kernel is the zero bundle and $r'=r$, so it reads $\gamma_{a,E'}=(-1)^0c_0(0)\cdot\gamma_{a,E}$. The rank-zero convention in [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities] gives $c_0(0)=1$, and the supported composition product of [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus] has the identity class as unit. Hence $A_{a,E'}=A_{a,E}$ by Step 4. This checks isomorphic presentations without choosing local flags. The associative, pullback-functorial supported products asserted in the last sentence are already the supported-Hom products identified in Step 3.

split_report.summary: Seven-step split using the existing prime-power modified-blowup theorem at n=1 and the existing Chern/product calculus; explicitly proves the ordinary-Rees case, the quotient obstruction vanishing, uniqueness, restriction, arbitrary base change, and isomorphic-presentation invariance. Statement unchanged; no new nodes.
split_report.blueprint: lem-per-artin-gabber-affine-curve proof Step 3, dimension-normalized duality, via the existing regular-immersion and Gysin-normalization ancestry; the Expose XVI 2.2 construction supplies the supported class used in that normalization.

tool_uses.why: Generic conormal-graded-algebra identification used to recognize the Rees algebra; the current unit has no such algebraic interface.
Generic existence and affine-chart compatibility of relative Proj used to compare the modified construction with the glued ordinary blowup.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NY-b735359cd (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read all 7 steps and every cited statement, plus ILO XVI 2.2.1.1-2.2.3.2 (pp. 229-233) and the Stacks conormal tags. The split adds no new nodes and leaves the statement unchanged. Step 1 applies lem-per-modified-blowup-generalized-class at n=1, and its hypotheses match. Step 2 proves the ordinary-blowup clause directly from psi being an isomorphism (the generalized node only covers regular i): the fibre product projects isomorphically onto J^a, so A is the Rees algebra, and relative Proj and the main-20261015 glue datum both build the scheme from the same affine models. The local-model definition is used but not cited; this is advisory only. Steps 3-5 are correct: xi*Q_E = (-1)^r c_r agrees with ILO Def. 2.2.2.5 and Lemma 2.2.2.6, existence and uniqueness come from the exact sequence for support Y, and p^* is injective as the degree-zero summand of the projective-bundle decomposition. Step 6 uses the node's arbitrary-base-change clause and never claims the blowup itself commutes with base change, consistent with the nil-immersion in ILO 2.2.1.5. Step 7 uses the surjection formula with K=0 and c_0(0)=1. Edge cases checked: r=1, empty W, W=T, l=2, and the effective Cartier sign. The item's dependency closure does not contain the item, so there is no cycle. The item is now essentially the n=1 case of a pre-existing Z/l^n node (the known per-family overlap); maintainer note: its citers could cite the generalized node directly. I accept the requested tool_uses (conormal graded algebra, relative-Proj existence). No SGA source is used. No changes.
